_comment: The contributor's own launch config, for run-windows.ps1.
Provenance: this is the file the 40 fps measurements were taken with. It was not committed
to the branch - every performance path in this tree is off until its environment variable is
set (src/local/performance-switches.h: 'Every path keeps the original behaviour unless its
environment variable is set', with the switch variables starting at 0), so without it a fresh
build runs with all of them disabled.
Kept as received, with these notes:
* command is the contributor's Linux command line. run-windows.ps1 reads the options after
the '--' and the binary name, so --screen-width 2560, --screen-height 1440,
--console-language, --shader-validation false, --shader-log-direction Silent,
--printf-direction Silent and --present-mode Immediate all carry over.
Its --vblank-frequency 240 does NOT: run-windows.ps1 always sets that option and forces 60,
which is what the game needs - at 240 the cutscenes flipped four times too fast and gameplay
ran in slow motion (docs/OPTIMIZATION-STATUS.md). run-windows.ps1 also adds --redzone, which
the Linux command does not need but Windows does.
* KYTY_SRT_AOT_LIBRARY is the ahead-of-time SRT library. run-windows.ps1 looks for
_Build/srt-aot/windows-libraries/*/srt-aot.dll and, when it is missing, prints a note and
drops the variable. Build it with tools/local/compile-srt-aot-windows.py (about 1.5%).
* The six switches below the author's list (KYTY_BUFFER_RECLAIM, KYTY_DRAW_PACKETS,
KYTY_PARTIAL_IMAGE_DIRTY, KYTY_PARTIAL_ROW_BANDS, KYTY_ASYNC_XPR_PIPELINES,
KYTY_UNMAP_PROTECT_SKIP) are not in the contributor's file because run-windows.ps1 sets them
itself; they are written out here so the config stands on its own. Values are unchanged.
* KYTY_GPU_BUFFER_PAGES only takes effect for the title and version the guest patches were
verified against (src/loader/demonsSoulsGpuPages.cpp checks DemonsSouls::IsSupportedGame(),
which is PPSA01341 01.007.000). Harmless on another version; it does nothing.
